name: MasterDnsVPN
description: A DNS tunnel to your own MasterDnsVPN server, for networks where little but DNS gets through. You need the server and a domain delegated to it.
config_template:
PROTOCOL_TYPE = "SOCKS5"
LISTEN_IP = "127.0.0.1"
LISTEN_PORT = {listen_port}
SOCKS5_AUTH = false
LOCAL_DNS_ENABLED = false
DATA_ENCRYPTION_METHOD = {field.encryption}
ENCRYPTION_KEY = {field.key:json}
RESOLVER_BALANCING_STRATEGY = 3
PACKET_DUPLICATION_COUNT = 3
SETUP_PACKET_DUPLICATION_COUNT = 4
LOG_LEVEL = "INFO"

fields.label: Tunnel domain
fields.hint: Your server's DOMAIN, e.g. v.example.com. Several are comma-separated and must all lead to the same server.

fields.label: Encryption method
fields.hint: The server's DATA_ENCRYPTION_METHOD: 0 none, 1 XOR, 2 ChaCha20, 3/4/5 AES-128/192/256-GCM.

fields.label: Encryption key
fields.hint: The contents of the server's key file. Not needed with method 0.

fields.label: DNS resolvers
fields.hint: One per line: 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1:5353, 192.168.1.0/30 or [2001:4860:4860::8888]:53. More working resolvers make the tunnel faster and steadier.
